cases.source: -I can pay for it if you need it.
cases.reference: Ég get greitt fyrir bílinn ef þess gerist þörf.
cases.note_zh: The source says only it; the reference explicitly adds the car, bílinn, unsupported by the isolated pair.
cases.note_en: The reference specifies the car (bílinn),an entity unsupported by the standalone source's it.

cases.source: Treatment with PREZISTA should be discontinued if such a condition develops.
cases.reference: Hætta skal meðferð með PREZISTA ef alvarleg útbrot koma fram.
cases.note_zh: The reference specifies serious rash for an unspecified such a condition. The isolated source cannot justify that clinical condition; context is needed.
cases.note_en: The reference resolves such a condition into serious rash;the standalone source cannot support that specificity without prior context.

cases.source: It also allows Member States to derogate from its provisions in the case of undertakings providing exclusively urban, suburban or regional transport.
cases.reference: Í reglugerðinni er aðildarríkjunum einnig heimilað að veita undanþágur frá ákvæðum hennar þegar um er að ræða fyrirtæki sem eingöngu annast flutninga í þéttbýli, í úthverfum og á svæðavísu.
cases.note_zh: The reference interprets It as Regulation, although the isolated source does not identify the legal instrument. As with earlier explicit referents, context is needed.
cases.note_en: The reference resolves It into a Regulation although the standalone source does not specify the instrument type;this needs prior context.

cases.source: “Finding the organohalogen Freon-40 near these young, Sun-like stars was surprising,” said Edith Fayolle, a researcher with the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics in Cambridge, Massachusetts in the USA, and lead author of the new paper.
cases.reference: „Það kom okkur á óvart að finna lífræna halógeninn Freon-40 nálægt þessari ungu stjörnu sem líkist sólinni,“ sagði Edith Fayolle hjá Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics í Cambridge í Massachusetts í Bandaríkjunum, aðalhöfundur greinarinnar um rannsóknina.
cases.note_zh: Source Sun-like stars is plural, but reference þessari ungu stjörnu specifies one young star, changing number.
cases.note_en: Plural Sun-like stars becomes the singular þessari ungu stjörnu,a changed quantity.

cases.source: “While astronomers are often limited by the power of their telescopes, in some cases our ability to see detail is hugely boosted by natural lenses, created by the Universe,” explains lead author Hugo Messias of the Universidad de Concepción (Chile) and the Centro de Astronomia e Astrofísica da Universidade de Lisboa (Portugal).
cases.reference: „Þótt stærð sjónauka takmarki störf stjörnufræðinga er í sumum tilvikum hægt að greina mun fínni smáatriði með hjálp náttúrulegra linsa sem alheimurinn hefur búið til,“ segir Hugo Messier stjörnufræðingur við Universidad de Concepción í Chile og Centro de Astronomia e Astrofísica da Universidade de Lisboa í Portúgal, aðalhöfundur greinar um rannsóknina.
cases.note_zh: Hugo Messias becomes Hugo Messier, a clear named-entity error; telescope power is also recast as size.
cases.note_en: Hugo Messias becomes Hugo Messier,a clear named-entity error;instrument power is also recast as size.

cases.source: A higher incidence, although still rare, of hypersensitivity reactions including skin rash, SJS or TEN in patients of Asian origin has been reported (see section 4.8).
cases.reference: Mjög sjaldan hefur verið tilkynnt um ofnæmisviðbrögð þar með talin útbrot í húð, Stevens-Johnson heilkenni (SJS) eða eitrunardreplos húðþekju (Toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN)) hjá sjúklingum af asískum uppruna (sjá kafla 4.8).
cases.note_zh: The reference preserves rare adverse reactions and population but drops the higher-incidence comparative-risk qualifier.
cases.note_en: The rare reaction and population remain,but the higher-incidence comparative risk is omitted.
